//***********************************************************************************************************
// Here are two articles to help you get started with KQL:
// KQL reference guide - https://aka.ms/KQLguide
// SQL - KQL conversions - https://aka.ms/sqlcheatsheet
//***********************************************************************************************************

// Use "take" to view a sample number of records in the table and check the data.
YOUR_TABLE_HERE
| take 100

// See how many records are in the table.
YOUR_TABLE_HERE
| count

// This query returns the number of ingestions per hour in the given table.
YOUR_TABLE_HERE
| summarize IngestionCount = count() by bin(ingestion_time(), 1h)

station_status
| count

dim_station
| count

dim_weather
| count

// 1a. Muestra de filas
station_status
| take 10

// 1b. Esquema (columnas y tipos)
station_status
| getschema

// 2. Estaciones y rango de fechas
station_status
| summarize stations = dcount(station_id), rows = count(), first_at = min(snapshot_at), last_at = max(snapshot_at)

// 3. Lecturas por estado
station_status
| summarize rows = count() by status

// 4. Estación 1, 15 de octubre, ordenada por hora (20 primeras filas)
station_status
| where station_id == 1 and snapshot_at >= datetime(2025-10-15) and snapshot_at < datetime(2025-10-16)
| project snapshot_at, bikes_available, docks_available
| sort by snapshot_at asc
| take 20

// 5. Las 10 estaciones con mayor ocupación media
station_status
| extend capacity = bikes_available + docks_available
| where capacity > 0
| extend occupancy = todouble(bikes_available) / capacity
| summarize avg_occupancy = avg(occupancy) by station_id
| top 10 by avg_occupancy desc

// 5b. Las 10 estaciones con mayor ocupación media (con mínimo de lecturas)
station_status
| extend capacity = bikes_available + docks_available
| where capacity > 0
| extend occupancy = todouble(bikes_available) / capacity
| summarize avg_occupancy = avg(occupancy), readings = count() by station_id
| where readings > 1000
| top 10 by avg_occupancy desc

// 6. Bicis medias por hora local del día
station_status
| extend local_hour = hourofday(datetime_utc_to_local(snapshot_at, "Europe/Madrid"))
| summarize avg_bikes = avg(bikes_available) by local_hour
| sort by local_hour asc
| render columnchart

// 7. Serie diaria de bicis disponibles por estación (media)
station_status
| summarize avg_bikes = avg(bikes_available) by day = bin(snapshot_at, 1d)
| render timechart

// 8. Laborables frente a fin de semana, por hora local
station_status
| extend local_ts = datetime_utc_to_local(snapshot_at, "Europe/Madrid")
| extend is_weekend = toint(dayofweek(local_ts) / 1d) in (0, 6)
| summarize weekday = avgif(bikes_available, not(is_weekend)), weekend = avgif(bikes_available, is_weekend) by local_hour = hourofday(local_ts)
| sort by local_hour asc
| render linechart

// 9. Barrios con más lecturas de estaciones vacías (join con dim_station)
station_status
| where bikes_available == 0 and status == "IN_SERVICE"
| summarize empty_readings = count() by station_id
| join kind=inner (dim_station | project station_id, neighbourhood) on station_id
| summarize empty_readings = sum(empty_readings) by neighbourhood
| top 10 by empty_readings desc

// 10. % de lecturas con la estación vacía, por distrito
dim_station
| project station_id, district
| join kind=inner station_status on station_id
| summarize readings = count(), empty_pct = round(100.0 * countif(bikes_available == 0) / count(), 2) by district
| sort by empty_pct desc

// 11. Última lectura de cada estación (10 filas)
station_status
| summarize arg_max(snapshot_at, bikes_available, docks_available, status) by station_id
| take 10

// 12. Bicis medias según la temperatura (tramos de 5 grados)
station_status
| extend hour_local = bin(datetime_utc_to_local(snapshot_at, "Europe/Madrid"), 1h)
| summarize avg_bikes = avg(bikes_available) by hour_local
| join kind=inner dim_weather on hour_local
| where isnotnull(temperature_c)
| summarize avg_bikes = avg(avg_bikes), hours = count() by temp_band = bin(temperature_c, 5)
| sort by temp_band asc

// 13. Efecto de la lluvia, solo horas diurnas (8 a 20 h) para no mezclar con el ciclo del día
station_status
| extend hour_local = bin(datetime_utc_to_local(snapshot_at, "Europe/Madrid"), 1h)
| summarize avg_bikes = avg(bikes_available) by hour_local
| where hourofday(hour_local) between (8 .. 20)
| join kind=inner dim_weather on hour_local
| where isnotnull(precipitation_mm)
| summarize avg_bikes = avg(avg_bikes), hours = count() by weather = iff(precipitation_mm > 0, "rain", "dry")

// 14a. Crear la función almacenada
.create-or-alter function with (docstring = "Average bikes and docks per local hour", folder = "bicing")
hourly_occupancy() {
    station_status
    | extend hour_local = bin(datetime_utc_to_local(snapshot_at, "Europe/Madrid"), 1h)
    | summarize avg_bikes = avg(bikes_available), avg_docks = avg(docks_available), readings = count() by hour_local
}

// 14b. Usarla como si fuera una tabla
hourly_occupancy()
| join kind=inner dim_weather on hour_local
| take 5

// 15a. Crear la vista materializada (asíncrona, con backfill)
.create async materialized-view with (backfill = true) hourly_station_mv on table station_status
{
    station_status
    | summarize avg_bikes = avg(bikes_available), readings = count() by station_id, hour_utc = bin(snapshot_at, 1h)
}

// 15b. Comprobar que cuadra con la tabla original
hourly_station_mv
| summarize view_rows = count(), total_readings = sum(readings)

// 10-invertida. Tabla grande a la izquierda del join
station_status
| join kind=inner (dim_station | project station_id, district) on station_id
| summarize readings = count(), empty_pct = round(100.0 * countif(bikes_available == 0) / count(), 2) by district
| sort by empty_pct desc

.show commands-and-queries
| where CommandType == "Query"
| top 10 by StartedOn desc
| project StartedOn, Duration, State, TotalCpu, MemoryPeak, Text

.show commands-and-queries
| where CommandType == "Query" and Text has "district"
| top 5 by StartedOn desc
| project StartedOn, Duration, TotalCpu, MemoryPeak, Text
